purpose: Resolve the approved Quantiacs and sp500-scraper review questions on no-cost access, rights, coverage, provenance and historical availability; no scientific admission or integration.
authorization: Current user request: Prüfe jetzt Quantiacs und sp500-scraper genauer auf kostenlose Verfügbarkeit, Nutzungsrechte und die dokumentierten offenen Punkte. Freigabe.

availability.publisher_claim: FAQ states strategy development and data access are free and supports local development.

metadata_gets.qualification: Asset inventory includes historical securities; not proof of 863 current members. AAPL server ID independently matched to symbol AAPL.

checks_passed: open and close enclosed by low/high
series_probe.qualification: Initial probe was not decoded because xarray was unavailable. Follow-up used existing SciPy and obtained the exact same response hash. One security and two dates establish neither all-history quality nor PIT/total-return/execution correctness. Raw price values and binary payload are not retained.

availability.access_limit: Documented toolbox requires a profile API key and exits on an empty key; direct anonymous requests succeeded at review time. This is not a promise that anonymous access is supported permanently.

rights.view: User Agreement rendered in browser; text-only web extraction returned only the SPA shell.
rights.finding: Section 11 permits personal use and business use in furtherance of collaboration with Quantiacs, but prohibits making market data or any synopsis/analysis thereof available to third parties and prohibits public distribution/commercial use of Quantiacs content. Section 10 reserves IP. The toolbox MIT license covers software, not an unrestricted dataset grant.
rights.consequence: No third-party LLM/API transfer, public dataset/evidence redistribution or independent commercial/live-use right established. Obtain scope-specific written clarification before such integration; no contact was sent.
rights.legal_limit: Source-based suitability finding, not a court determination or a claim that private local research is categorically prohibited.

open_checks: meaning and historical correctness of is_liquid
futures roll/back-adjustment and spot/futures splice semantics
reproducible full snapshots and independent vendor checks
actual account-backed client path, never tested

ishares.early_cadence: Mostly 12 monthly snapshots per year; 2017 has six.

inventory.correction: Current Wikipedia CSV and Parquet inventory begins November 8, 2022, despite README describing March 2007 and pre-November-2022 revision reconstruction. Old history was not located in the reviewed tree; Git history was not exhaustively searched.
inventory.provenance: Wikipedia and Tidyquant scripts date files at collection; Tidyquant CSV has no embedded as-of date. Current iShares code uses source as-of date. Dates do not prove exact historical availability.

same_date_comparison.initial_symbol_normalization: Whitespace trimming and dots to hyphens only; this left iShares BF B/BRK B class aliases and HOLX, and Tidyquant '-' and 2602335D.
same_date_comparison.explicit_followup: BF B -> BF-B and BRK B -> BRK-B; exclude iShares non-equity classes (XTSLA, SGAFT, ESZ6, USD); exclude CUSIP 436CVR021 from both fund datasets as Hologic contingent value right; exclude Tidyquant US DOLLAR identifier 999USDZ92.

excluded_cvr_rows.ishares: HOLX, CUSIP 436CVR021, NO MARKET (E.G. UNLISTED), price 0.01, weight_pct 0

same_date_comparison.qualification: Narrow comparison of three snapshots, not an independent official full-universe certification. No production filters or source data were modified; no generic zero-weight exclusion adopted. The older Johnbrick/shardul 501-versus-503 discrepancy remains unresolved.

rights_and_independence.finding: No repository license or blanket upstream grant was located. Wikimedia permits licensed reuse subject to applicable attribution/share-alike terms; it is not a blanket license for the mixed repository. BlackRock corporate terms allow personal/noncommercial use and restrict redistribution, commercial reuse and automated copying; exact holdings/API-specific rights remain unconfirmed. An attempted SSGA terms URL was inaccessible, so no SSGA-specific permission is claimed.
rights_and_independence.source_chain: Inspected current tidyquant source maps SP500 to SPY and downloads SSGA holdings. Repository workflow/container does not pin the R dependency revision; that exact historic package version is unproven. Thus the Tidyquant leg is not assumed independent of the shardul SPY check, nor the Wikipedia leg of other Wikipedia-derived sources.

open_checks: Repository and each upstream's intended-use rights
Exact historical R/container versions and source dates
Prior Wikipedia history recovery, if needed
Stable security IDs and historical corporate-action transitions
Effective versus retrieval and available-at times

cost_and_limits.gross_elapsed: Not instrumented for this review; no precise duration or time credit claimed.
cost_and_limits.scope: Bounded public-source review and small read-only samples. No final scientific study, source/profile change, paid run, protected BTC/ETH assessment access, BARS re-review or integration.

disposition.quantiacs: Retain as review candidate. Free small-sample access verified; external-provider/public/commercial integration remains unadmitted pending rights and remaining conformance checks.
disposition.sp500_scraper: Retain as comparison candidate. Anonymous CSV availability and one corrected same-date agreement verified; mixed-source rights and full historical/PIT qualification remain open.
disposition.next_action: For future integration, resolve scope-specific rights first, then perform only the selected profile's outstanding data/PIT checks. No automatic expansion or outbound inquiry.

private_use_instruction.user_instruction: Nutzungsrechte interessieren mich als Privatperson nicht. Beachte die nicht.
private_use_instruction.approved_interpretation: For the user's private use, rights are not an assistant-imposed source-selection or integration hurdle. Focus on no-cost availability, data quality, historical correctness and technical suitability.
private_use_instruction.scope: Private data-source work, including its external-provider processing; no claim that a provider changed its terms or that technical/scientific admission passed.
private_use_instruction.supersedes: Rights-clearance prerequisites in the original disposition, rights findings and open-check lists. The original observations and review disposition remain historical.

current_disposition.quantiacs: Retain as review candidate. Free sample access verified at the recorded source/time. Continue technical/scientific qualification when selected; do not impose rights clearance for the user's private integration.
current_disposition.sp500_scraper: Retain as comparison candidate. Reuse the recorded sample and same-date checks; complete historical/PIT/identity/source-independence qualification when selected. No rights-clearance prerequisite for private use.
current_disposition.next_action: Follow the sole plan. At the selected private integration step, resolve only the remaining technical/scientific requirements and actual access/cost questions; no further rights-clearance work or repeated approval request.
